title: WSL distributions
whyItMatters: Each registered WSL distro holds a Linux filesystem with its own files and shell history. Missing it would leave a whole user environment unaccounted for.
source: Microsoft Learn: WSL distribution list under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Lxss - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/disk-space
notes: One GUID subkey per installed distribution. Names, BasePath values and VHD files are not read; only key, value and subkey counts are reported.
